description:
Delete or detach things. Permanent deletes (project, category, task, requisite, note, sticky note, question, resource, meeting) need confirm=true where stated; detaching a resource, task, question, Jira issue or AI session from what it is linked to.

Pass one of these as `action`, with its arguments in `params`:
- karea_delete_project - Permanently delete a project and everything inside it (tasks, categories, notes, history). [required: name; optional: confirm]
- karea_delete_category - Permanently delete a category AND every task inside it, including history. [required: name; optional: projectId]
- karea_delete_task - Permanently delete a task and its history. [required: task; optional: confirm, projectId]
- karea_delete_requisite - Permanently delete a closing requisite from a task, by ID. [required: task, requisiteId; optional: projectId]
- karea_delete_note - Permanently delete a note from a task, by note ID. [required: task, noteId; optional: projectId]
- karea_delete_sticky_note - Delete a sticky note. [required: noteId]
- karea_delete_question - Permanently delete an open question. [required: questionId]
- karea_delete_resource - Permanently delete a resource (text or file) by ID. [required: resourceId]
- karea_delete_meeting - Delete a meeting permanently. [required: meetingId, confirm]
- karea_unlink_resource_from_task - Remove the link between a resource and a task. [required: resourceId, task; optional: projectId]
- karea_unlink_task_from_meeting - Remove the link between a task and a meeting. [required: meetingId, task; optional: projectId]
- karea_unlink_question_from_meeting - Remove the link between an open question and a meeting. [required: meetingId, questionId]
- karea_unlink_jira - Remove the JIRA link from a Karea task [required: task; optional: projectId]
- karea_unlink_session - Remove a previously-linked AI session from a task. [required: task, sessionRowId; optional: projectId]

For the full parameter schema of any action, call karea_help with that action name.

action.description: Which operation to perform. See the list in this tool's description.

params.description: Arguments for the chosen action, as an object. Omit for actions that take none.

name: karea_delete
title: Delete or unlink in Karea
